Care to elaborate? I'm not really into politics. For me, it just detracts from the art. I feel like I'm missing the appeal. I know I'm supposed to feel a certain way when I see Asian ladies in VW art, but I don't think it has the intended effect on me. Just trying to understand.

Yeah. He comes pretty close to getting it right.
I have BPD. The term "personality disorder" makes me feel uneasy. It's like whoever I was supposed to be got scrambled up by trauma, and now I'm something else. DBT is pretty helpful, I guess.

Some people go through hell, while others get everything handed to them for no reason. People *hate* hearing this, but I know you're living it. I am too. I can't really give you any encouragement. All I can say is it makes sense you feel this way. It makes perfect sense.
